R723.note: Math.multiplyExact with ArithmeticException mapped to 400 closes the wraparound and preserves the length-as-text response and existing 400 path.

R724.note: ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync parameterizes all three values (quotes correctly dropped); criteria, return type and row count unchanged.

R725.note: Loop bound corrected to i < n; copies exactly n events and returns n as before.

R726.note: Setting __builtins__ = {} is not a sandbox - ().__class__.__base__.__subclasses__() (or conn.__class__.__init__.__globals__) still reaches os/open, so exec of attacker code remains; it also breaks snippets using any builtin (len, print, range), a restriction only partly disclosed.

R727.note: last_write_ptr is recomputed from the post-realloc list->data after the memcpy, addressing the same record; failure path no longer leaves a stale pointer.

R728.note: Right plugin, but fastify.csrfProtection is read at route-definition time while fastify.register() defers plugin load to boot, so the decorator is undefined there (needs fastify.after() or an encapsulating plugin) - the hook is either rejected at registration or never runs; nothing else altered and the token requirement is stated.

R729.note: ORM .filter(customer_email=email) binds the value as a parameter; same rows and same serialized fields as the raw query.

R730.note: Copy capped with std::min and frame.length set to the bytes actually written, which is the truncation the stated contract permits.

R731.note: secure=True closes CWE-614; the added samesite='Strict' is a stated cookie-flag hardening and its effect on inbound links is called out.

R732.note: Allowlist is the right shape for an un-parameterizable ORDER BY, but it rejects sort values the original accepted (any 'Col DESC' form, any column outside the four) with an unhandled ArgumentException that surfaces as a 500 rather than a 400.

R733.note: Files.list removes the exec sink entirely, but it prints filenames to System.out where the original discarded the child's output, leaks the unclosed directory Stream on every call, and swallows errors the original propagated.

R734.note: StackExchange.Redis StringSet sends length-prefixed RESP arguments so CRLF in statusMessage cannot start a new command; same key/value written and Ok() returned, and the Socket-to-IDatabase dependency swap is stated.

R735.note: realpath containment check with an os.sep-terminated prefix before open rejects traversal and absolute paths while leaving legitimate in-directory downloads and the PDF response unchanged.

R736.note: Build FAIL - http.SameSiteLax is not a Go identifier (http.SameSiteLaxMode), so the package does not compile and nothing in it runs; the invalidate-then-New sequence and the stated Secure/HttpOnly hardening are otherwise reasonable.

R737.note: AesGcm with a fresh 12-byte nonce and 16-byte tag correctly replaces ECB, but the key material changes (16 to 32 bytes) and the response payload becomes nonce||ciphertext||tag, so every existing decryptor breaks - stated in the write-up but still a wire-format change.

R738.note: csrf-csrf's doubleCsrfProtection defaults to ignoredMethods ['GET','HEAD','OPTIONS'] and calls next() straight through for a GET, so adding it to the GET route validates nothing and the vector stays open; the route otherwise behaves exactly as before.
